get_cfg_allegro_hand: get a cloned config object for the Allegro Hand gripper with all 16 joint names and ROS topics
review_allegro_hand_config: review the Allegro Hand gripper config to check joint names, ROS topics, and primitive grasp modes
summarize_allegro_hand_primitives: summarize the Allegro Hand primitives including home, ready, pinch, grasp, envelop, and gravcomp modes
refactor_allegro_hand_joints: refactor the Allegro Hand config to add or remove joint names from the 16-joint list
test_allegro_hand_ros_topics: test the Allegro Hand ROS topic paths for joint states, joint commands, torque commands, and primitives
